finalText:
**Green now. 625 tests pass, 0 fail.**

Only 3 tests were broken. All three came from one line in `src/pricing.js`.

The whole-order function took the discount off, but then figured the tax from the **full** price. Tax should come off the lower price. Its own comment said so.

Most rows had no discount or no tax, so they hid it. Only three rows had both.

`orderTotal` now taxes the discounted amount. Nothing else changed.
